description: CFD 2D wave tank (10 m, 2nd-order Stokes H 0.04 m, L 3 m) with PLIC VOF (F 80 4); the beach is a B 107 zone (4 m at x+) without B 99. Before IOWAVE patch 0064 the beach damped the velocities but vof_relax left the free surface alone (only B 99 1 / 2): the gauges at 7 and 9 m in the beach.
